name: Toy (tilt-shift)
one_line: A photographed miniature: one sharp band, the rest melting into soft blur.

blur.help: How strongly the top and bottom of the picture melt away. 0 = off.
blur.label: Blur

band.help: Where the sharp band sits: -1 bottom of the screen, 0 middle, 1 top.
band.label: Sharp band height

depthBlur.help: Extra blur for things nearer or further than the focus.
depthBlur.label: Depth blur

orthographic.note: Only the band blur (sharp across the middle, soft above and below) works; a flat camera has no depth, so "Depth blur" is switched off and the look focuses on nothing in particular.

measured.how: hidden Chromium on the kit's test laptop, whole frame read back from the graphics chip; machine load changes it
